scientific_integrity.analytical_proof: Provided for the exact positivity criterion, strict majorization, extremizers, dimension and singular asymptotics.
scientific_integrity.computational_support: A standard-library checker performed 3474 supplementary exact and numerical checks; the finite replay is not substituted for the analytic proof.
scientific_integrity.independence: No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_integrity.originality_scope: Novelty is asserted for the combined directionally weighted cube result, not the general Markov-resolvent criterion, the Walsh basis, convexity, or majorization theory.

scientific_limitations: Each coordinate has a common positive rate across its edges; arbitrary independently weighted edges are not included.
The dimension expansion holds for balanced directional rates at fixed total rate; the singular rate-floor expansion holds at fixed dimension and total rate.
The threshold concerns entrywise positivity of the end-step matrix, not positivity of internal stages or consistency of a nonlinear spatial discretization.
A 1993 closely related specialist article was only accessible as an abstract, leaving residual priority risk.
title: Strict majorization and sharp Crank–Nicolson positivity on anisotropic Boolean cubes
